video_title: Workouts. Family. Horses. And the drive to keep winning.

quotes.speaker: Nikola Jokić
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jokić on Aaron Gordon's unique skill set in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: I think there is no player like him in NBA, you cannot find another person like him
quotes.quote: I think there is no player like him in NBA, you cannot find another person like him.

quotes.speaker: Nikola Jokić
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jokić on Aaron Gordon's work ethic and shooting improvement
quotes.excerpt: He's definitely putting the work in, he's the guy who doesn't like to be bad.
quotes.quote: He's definitely putting the work in, he's the guy who doesn't like to be bad. He likes to develop his game, he wants to be better. Body wise, shooting wise, skill wise, he's always developing himself. In the last couple seasons, he was shooting the ball really well for us. I think in one moment he was leading the league last year in three-point percentage, so when he shoots like that, we are going to be really dangerous.

quotes.speaker: Nikola Jokić
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jokić on the high level of talent across the NBA
quotes.excerpt: I think the league is so talented right now that in every team you have two, three plus players
quotes.quote: I think the league is so talented right now that in every team you have two, three plus players that are really talented and they can be stars or superstars. To pick two teams or a couple teams is going to be hard, just because to be a fan of basketball, and especially an NBA fan right now, it's amazing just because how talented the league is and how many good players are out there.

quotes.speaker: Nikola Jokić
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jokić on the difficulty of repeating as NBA champions
quotes.excerpt: I think this year for sure, because when you want something you already want it.
quotes.quote: I think this year for sure, because when you want something you already want it, and we didn't win this, so obvious this is going to be the harder one to do it.
